protocol: Five alternating pairs each of separate clean and allocation-sampled 60-second walks, five-second warm-up; forced GC before each measured window; one Chrome at a time. GPU counters use one separate five-second run per tier.
notes: The initial walking batch did not record inner viewport or render dimensions; later diagnostics with the same driver record them explicitly.
Chrome V8 sampling is probabilistic. Heap-drop sums are reclamation proxies, not GC pauses.
Dynamic NPC choices are not fully seeded; the real controlled actor follows the same key trace but surrounding activity can vary.
GPU counters and CPU submission timings are instrumented and are not clean frame-rate acceptance.
